The Department of Mathematics and Statistics offers the following graduate credentials:
Master of Science in Mathematics
Master of Science in Statistics
Doctor of Philosophy in Mathematics
Mathematics Graduate Certificate
How to Apply
All applications are submitted directly through the Texas Tech University Graduate School.
Requirements generally include:
Completed online application
Non-refundable application fee
Official transcripts from all previous college or university coursework
Additional Requirements for the M.S. and Ph.D. Programs
Three letters of reference
Resume or curriculum vitae
Optional: cover letter or statement of purpose
International Applicants
International applicants must also provide proof of English proficiency and a financial
statement demonstrating sufficient funding for tuition and living expenses. For the
most current instructions, refer to the Graduate School website.
Admission Terms
Fall Admission: Certificate, M.A., M.S., and Ph.D. programs
Summer Admission: Graduate Certificate only
Assistantships
Applicants to the M.S. and Ph.D. programs are considered for graduate teaching assistantships. Positions are limited and not guaranteed. For full consideration, all application
materials should be submitted by December 15 for Fall admission.
Next Steps
Have questions or need guidance? Our advisors are available to help you navigate your
academic options and next steps.
